sources.entry: Isso - Lightweight commenting server written in Python and Javascript. It aims to be a drop-in replacement for Disqus. (Source Code) MIT Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: Isso is a lightweight, self-hosted commenting server written in Python and JavaScript that aims to be a drop-in replacement for Disqus.
summary.what_it_does: Isso provides a commenting system that you run on your own server and embed on web pages through a single JavaScript file (about 65kB, 20kB gzipped, per the README). Users can write comments in Markdown and can edit or delete their own comments within 15 minutes by default. Comments can be held in a moderation queue and stay hidden from the public until activated. It stores data in an SQLite backend. The README also says Disqus and WordPress comments can be imported for migration. The JS client is configurable.
use_cases: replace Disqus with a self-hosted option
migrate Disqus comments to your own server
moderate comments before they are published
embed a commenting widget on a static site
how_to_run: Follow the Quickstart guide in the documentation
docker pull ghcr.io/isso-comments/isso:latest (see Using Docker in the docs)
notable: Drop-in replacement for Disqus, with Disqus and WordPress comment import
Moderation queue before comments become public
SQLite backend, no external database mentioned
caveats: Requires Python 3.7+ with development headers, SQLite 3.3.8 or later, and a working C compiler for the pip install path
Setup beyond the quickstart is documented elsewhere; the README itself gives only brief install steps
